desc: Moon spirit: deep violet gown with gold moon marks, three stacked layers of violet butterfly wings on each side with gold crescents, gold crescent crown, long ribbons, holds a small lantern. Face: closed happy arc eyes. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Face is a solid black void with the described eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
